text: {"label":"Matching Law and Choice Allocation","definition":"Work on the matching law and generalized matching law: theoretical models, statistical estimation methods, and applications describing how responding is allocated among alternatives in laboratory, sports, games, clinical, and big-data settings.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Concerns quantitative choice and the allocation of behavior relative to reinforcement, not the matching-to-sample procedure, equivalence relations, or equivalence class formation, which share only the word 'matching.'"}
